name: Twin Love
source:
In Twin Love, you play as a high school boy who meets and befriends twin girls who just moved into town and are now going to his school. The pair look identical, but their personalities and preferences couldn't be further apart.

The older sister, Ayame, is outgoing and athletic, and has a sharp tongue.

The younger sister, Yukime, is shy and demure, with a kind heart that shines all the more in comparison to her sister.

In less than two weeks, you'll be able to become friends with both of them, but maybe there's a chance for something more?

[Edited from [url=https://levinmasterrain.itch.io/twinlove-r]Itch.io[/url]]
